title: HCP — Read Own Grant — payload
description: The request payload of the HCP 2.0-draft-3 Read own grant operation (HCP 5.2.6; `GET /v2/grants` with a Context Client's token in HCP 9.2): an HCP Client reads the grant under which it acts. The request carries only the token, which names the grant. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

accessToken.description: The HCP access token for the grant under which the client acts (HCP 12, 13), carried unchanged. HCP's HTTP binding sends it as a Bearer token (HCP 9.3); this member carries it in the document. The provider validates it exactly as over HTTP and treats it as opaque.

Response.title: HCP — Read Own Grant — response payload
Response.description: The HCP Read own grant result (HCP 5.2.6): the client's own grant, with the directives that apply to it. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

grant.description: The grant under which the client acts, and no other (HCP 5.2.6, 6.1.5). Where it is narrowed to particular entries, a Context Client receives their `ref`s, never their `id`s (HCP 5.2.6).

directives.description: The directives that apply to the grant (HCP 5.2.6, 6.4); empty when none applies.
